caption: Share with admin
message:
Sharing your project with your subscription administrator will temporarily upload your project to Scirra Ltd's server so they can access it. [a1]Privacy Policy[/a1]
[b]Note:[/b] this does not permanently save your project. Save your project another way to ensure your work is safe.

Choose a unique file name to help identify your project. This will be visible to your subscription administrator.
label: File name

completed.title: Successfully uploaded project
completed.message: Your project is now shared with your subscription administrator.

errors.failed: Failed to upload project ([i]{0}[/i]). Check your Internet connection is working and that you have the correct account details. Alternatively try sharing your project another way.
errors.subscription-expired: Failed to upload project: the associated subscription is not active. It may be expired or suspended.
errors.file-too-large: Failed to upload project: the project file is too large to share this way ({0}). Try sharing it a different way.
